$meta.north_star: light 'trading terminal' — monospace, high-contrast, calm, with a plain-English read beside every number
$meta.theme: light-only (recommended); tokens are theme-namespaced so a future dark 'control-room' can reuse the semantic layer
$meta.prime_directive: easy to operate, easy to control, not a messy mashup — one coherent visual language across every surface

ink.use: primary text, pill labels, NO_TRADE badge

bands._note: The core motif. Color is FUNCTIONAL only. Each band = {fg on white, bg tint, border, dot}. fg values are WCAG AA (>=4.5:1) on white; on the paired bg tint they exceed 7:1.

posture._note: Market posture badge. NO_TRADE inverts to ink so 'sit out' reads as the hardest state. DEGRADED (gray) is used only when data is stale — never show a confident green posture on old data.

mono.stack: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'Cascadia Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace
mono.rationale: widest weight range (400–700), excellent tabular figures, unambiguous 0/O and 1/l/I; Cascadia is the seed's lead and an acceptable alt, IBM Plex Mono reads slightly warmer
mono.always: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every numeric column so figures align

sans.use: ONLY the plain-English 'READ' / verdict prose beside numbers — never for chrome or data

headline_number.use: XP dial, EM, the 46% bias, readiness score

border.treatment: flat — NO gradients, NO shadows, NO decorative color or motion

pill_label.anatomy: ink pill + colored status dot + uppercase mono text

conditional_cell.anatomy: tabular-num value in a tinted chip whose band is chosen by threshold

verdict_layer._note: THE personality + the beginner explainability. Systematic slot under every data block.
verdict_layer.anatomy: mono verdict chip (e.g. 'SWING UP') + a sans 'READ' line prefixed by a small 9px ink-disabled 'READ' tag, above a 1px dashed divider
verdict_layer.rule: every data block gets exactly one READ line; never omit, never decorate

quadrant_card.anatomy: 3px colored left-rail + pill label + state + one-sentence question + 0-100 confidence bar + 2-3 metric chips + READ line
quadrant_card.grid_desktop: 4 cols equal (Dir A) OR 2x2 question-led (Dir B)

variants.A_instrument: 8 compact metric cards, each min-width 160px, colored left rail
variants.B_briefing: one wide posture banner: big badge + plain-English sentence + supporting chips + preferred/avoid rows

candidate_card.anatomy: symbol + setup + readiness score(0-100) + grade(A+..C) + mini chart w/ pivot line + evidence chips (named filters) + trade-plan box + 2-tap log-to-journal
candidate_card.hard_rule: NO buy/sell button anywhere — plan only

evidence_chip.use: traceability — every score names the filters that fired

heatmap_strip.anatomy: 132px row label + horizontal run of solid band.dot cells (green->red) over recent sessions
heatmap_strip.use: chart page: Minervini Pressure, Buy Risk, Trend Template

preset_chart_frame.anatomy: preset tabs + heat strips + candles(72%) + volume(28%) + price lines + side badges + risk box
preset_chart_frame.rule: switching presets NEVER mixes overlays from another preset

banner.anatomy: pulsing dot + bold title + sans explanation + action button, full-width, band-tinted
banner.use: stale data / auth-needed — impossible to miss

infodot.use: on any jargon term or column header -> 1-line plain-English definition (~40 terms)

beginner_expert_toggle.effect: flips label style + reveals/hides raw columns (RS, 20R, 50R, ADR) app-wide

shell.nav: top tab bar (recommended over left rail for 5 destinations + beginner clarity)

breakpoints.narrow: <=768 (single column, strip -> 2 rows of chips, universe -> horizontal scroll or accordion, sector -> accordion top 8)

density.beginner: plain-English lead; keep key numbers visible (XP, %>DMA, 4.5R); no more than ~3 raw numeric indicators per card before expansion
density.expert: adds raw columns app-wide: 20R, 50R, ADR, RS, bucket. Same data, higher density — never patronising

states._note: Beginner-safety lives here. Every data surface must design all five.
states.normal: fresh + populated; confident posture, full permission set
states.empty: valid 'nothing today' — '0 setups tonight — market is SELECTIVE, sit tight'; intentional, never blank/broken
states.stale: loud red banner + affected numbers de-emphasized (opacity .55, grayscale) + posture HARD-DEGRADES to gray; freshness dot red
states.auth_needed: Fyers token expired (~6am daily) -> orange reconnect banner + live surfaces marked stale + WebSocket source FAIL
states.loading: calm monospace-friendly shimmer skeletons; no layout shift on arrival

interaction.click_candidate: select -> full readiness evidence + trade plan
interaction.a11y: keyboard-navigable; ARIA labels on badges/cards; conditional green/red bands pass WCAG AA on white

non_goals: no black-box scores — every number traceable to named filters
no decorative color, gradients, shadows, or motion-for-motion
not a free-form charting platform — presets over indicator assembly
